A-la ni Tu-han Je-sus, mar-o-lop-o-lop au. I-ba-na hu-i-hut-hon ma-nang tu-di-a lao. I-ba-na do pa-to-gu, pa-sa-da ro-hang-ki. Ro di ba-nu-a gin-jang sai Je-sus do-ngan-ki.
